description: Break down LinkedIn campaign performance by a demographic dimension of the people who saw or clicked your ads. Pivot options: MEMBER_JOB_TITLE (which titles engage most), MEMBER_JOB_FUNCTION, MEMBER_SENIORITY (director vs. manager vs. C-suite), MEMBER_COMPANY (which accounts clicked), MEMBER_COMPANY_SIZE, MEMBER_INDUSTRY, MEMBER_COUNTRY_V2, MEMBER_REGION_V2. Returns impressions, clicks, spend, leads, and conversions per dimension value. Useful for buyer-persona fit analysis and ABM account-list validation.

pivot.description: Demographic dimension to break down by. MEMBER_JOB_TITLE / MEMBER_JOB_FUNCTION / MEMBER_SENIORITY are useful for persona fit; MEMBER_COMPANY / MEMBER_COMPANY_SIZE for ABM audience analysis; MEMBER_INDUSTRY for vertical benchmarking; MEMBER_COUNTRY_V2 / MEMBER_REGION_V2 for geo reporting.

name: li_get_demographics_report
